updates.label: Updates come from yilewang/llm-for-zotero, another listed project with the same add-on ID
updates.check: Zotero will update it to version 3.9.9 from yilewang/llm-for-zotero on GitHub (rated: Serious concerns found)

sourceTransparency.label: Readable code; not yet checked against the published source

dataSharing.label: Only contacts services we could identify

badges.label: Runs commands its AI assistant writes, with full access to your computer
badges.detail: It can run without showing you the code first

badges.label: Signs in using another app's identity
badges.detail: Signs in as Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot for VS Code

badges.label: Keeps its own tables in Zotero's database
Downloads a program and runs it
badges.detail: The first time you ask about a figure, it downloads a 265–491 MB bundle of Python and the Poppler PDF tools from the original llm-for-zotero developer's (not this fork's) GitHub release and runs it, without asking. The README doesn't mention it, and the download isn't checked against a fingerprint. We checked the macOS (Apple silicon) bundle: every file is standard software from conda-forge.

badges.label: A zotero:// link (a web page can open one) can make it install add-ons without asking you
A zotero:// link can make it run code if you approve a prompt
Reuses a sign-in you saved in another program
badges.detail: Reuses the sign-in you saved in Codex CLI

badges.label: Runs code it assembles while running
Works with files on your computer
Other programs on this computer can change your library through it
Lets programs on this computer connect through Zotero's built-in server

overall.label: high-concern
reasons: Runs commands its AI assistant writes, with full access to your computer
